label: Anthro
blurb: Anthropomorphic animal people: furred and feathered anthros, four-legged taurs and therianthropes caught mid-shift, for worlds built around them.
context: anthropomorphic character, an animal-featured person (not a plain human and not a plain animal)

wolf.label: Wolf anthro
wolf.features: a wolf-like muzzle, pointed furred ears, a thick tail and fur-covered paws in place of hands and feet

fox.label: Fox anthro
fox.features: a fox-like muzzle, large pointed ears, a bushy tail and fur-covered paws in place of hands and feet

feline.label: Feline anthro
feline.features: a feline muzzle, tufted ears, a long tail and soft fur-covered paws in place of hands and feet

rabbit.label: Rabbit anthro
rabbit.features: a rabbit-like face, long upright ears, a small cottontail and fur-covered paws in place of hands and feet

avian.label: Avian anthro
avian.features: a short beak, a feathered crest, feather-covered arms and taloned feet, with small wings folded at the back

reptile.label: Reptile anthro
reptile.features: smooth scaled skin, a reptilian snout, a long tail and clawed hands

bear.label: Bear anthro
bear.features: a bear-like muzzle, small rounded ears, a stocky fur-covered frame and clawed paws

therian.label: Therianthrope
therian.features: a mostly human face and build with a partial animal transformation breaking through: clawed hands, sharp animal-like eyes and patches of fur along the arms and neck

taur.label: Taur
taur.features: a human upper body and face on a four-legged, fur-covered animal lower body, with a long tail

dragontaur.label: Dragontaur
dragontaur.features: a human upper body and face on a four-legged, scaled dragon-like lower body, with a long tail and small horns

hobbies: chasing scents on the evening breeze
grooming out a tangled patch of fur
practicing forms with a favorite weapon
swimming in the river at dawn
tracking animal prints through the woods
listening for storms before they arrive
chewing on something when thinking hard
quirks: circling three times before sitting down
sniffing new people before trusting them
keeping one ear turned toward the door
burying favorite objects and forgetting where
napping in the sun whenever possible
goals: earning a place of respect in the settlement
learning the old herd-songs before they're lost
seeing the far mountains before {subj} settles down
mastering a craft {poss} kind is not known for
protecting the younger ones in the settlement
finding a cure for the sickness in the western woods
being welcomed home after years away
earning enough to never go hungry again
peeves: a wet coat that won't dry
being mistaken for a plain animal
being talked down to like a pet
accessories: a braided leather collar with a small charm
a satchel worn across the chest
a feather tucked behind one ear
a small bell on a cord
a wrapped bundle of dried herbs
a polished claw on a leather cord
a patterned scarf knotted at the neck
a simple ring on a cord
default_outfits: a simple tunic with a wide belt, sturdy trousers and worn boots

default_outfits.t: a simple wrap dress with a wide belt and soft shoes

default_outfits: a hooded travel cloak over a plain tunic, patched trousers and worn boots
_tables: The next two entries replace the shared tables in common.json for this setting only (same shape): a modest dye chance for the stylised streaks and accent colours common in anthro character design, and species-appropriate marks (fur patterns, notched ears, heterochromia) instead of the human ones. hair_styles, facial_hair and glasses are deliberately left at their human defaults: anthro art routinely gives a head-fur style, a chin tuft or glasses to a muzzled character without it reading as a mismatch, so no override was needed there. Per-species skin (coat/plumage/scale colour), hair_colors (head-fur/mane accent) and builds live on each entry in 'races' above, the same mechanism fantasy's elf and the adventurers'-guild's dragonkin already use; 'therian' deliberately has none of the three, so it rolls plain human skin, hair and any build -- the therianthrope is still mostly human, unlike the other species.

distinguishing.label: a distinctive patch of differently-coloured fur, feathers or scales
a notched or torn ear from an old scuffle
heterochromia, one eye a different colour from the other
an unusual marbled or brindle coat pattern
a distinctive marking down the front
a small chip out of one ear
an old, healed scratch across one cheek
a birthmark-like marking on one shoulder
